observations.code_quote: Note on `/v2/reporting/runs`: skipped deliberately. Each row is a report job the account created (`report_type`, `interval`, `status`, `result.row_count`), not the invoices, charges or refunds the report contains. The list has no pagination or date filter and returns at most the 500 most recent runs, so a table of it cannot hold full history. It also omits the download URL. The report data itself needs a different design: create a run (`POST /v2/reporting/runs`), poll it, then download the CSV or Parquet file. That is a write on the customer's account, and each interval can span 92 days at most.
